## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant automated tests.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behaviour changed.
- [ ] I checked numerical tolerances, units, and edge cases where applicable.
- [ ] I documented new scientific assumptions or parameter provenance.

Commands/results:

```text
# e.g. python -m pytest -q
```

## Scientific impact

If this PR changes scientific behaviour, briefly state:

- hypothesis or model component affected;
- assumptions introduced or changed;
- validation/reference data used;
- known limitations or uncertainty.

If there is no scientific-behaviour change, write **N/A**.

## Reproducibility

List any new dependencies, environment requirements, random seeds, external data, or steps needed to reproduce the result.

## Reviewer notes

Call out anything that deserves extra scrutiny, especially numerical stability, physical constraints, data leakage, benchmark criteria, or backwards compatibility.
